name: input
useFor: Use for one line of text: a handle, an email, a key. Pair it with Label (or Field) above it. Set aria-invalid when the value is rejected and say why below it; set readOnly for a value the person cannot change (it sits on the lilac with muted text). For search, put a 16px magnifier at the start with Input Group and keep type text.
constraints: A placeholder used as the only label
A gray field background for an editable value
type="search" (its clear button and styling differ by browser)
source: The Inkbox console's Input theme; Figma 427:2715: Form- Input in Create Agent Identity, Login and Vault
title: Input
description: The 40px pill field with the lilac-gray edge, 16px of padding and a light purple placeholder; the edge darkens under the pointer and turns purple with the soft ring on focus.
